copy_gaps: The 13:20 ▼ SELL stack ×4 row's Max ratio description: §7.1 L675-676 gives the form (bid first for sell; its ratio part follows from 420 %: 'ratio 4.2 to 1') and the 13:35 row's 'ask 228 vs bid 38, ratio 6.0 to 1', but no bid / ask volumes for this stack: E25-T06's bid_volume / ask_volume live, E18-D05 for the SYNTHETIC figure. An accessible description: not drawn.

The row ⋯'s accessible name: E18-D02 gives none, and CMP-002's label is mandatory (`15` L62); E11-D04 names SCR-045's 'Actions for 13:58' (the row's time; E11-D04 L190, L303), so 'Actions for 13:35' would be its analogue, for E18-D05 to key. An icon-only button: no visible text.

live_checks: No inst node on this board: every control is a composition (kit 'compose'), so no library set, variant prop or text layer needs verifying.
Glyphs: ▲ ▼ × in type.ui.body (Inter) and the en dash – in type.num.base (JetBrains Mono) render, no fallback box.

Icons: icon/check (color.text.primary) in the checked box and icon/more-horizontal × 3 (color.text.secondary: the header's and the two rows', each centred in a 32 × 32 CMP-002 IconButton composition) bind as the registry glyphs.

After relayout: the header and both rows are 2,536 px wide with no padding of their own, cells 227 / 551 / 616 / 324 / 259 / 519 / 40 px, each data cell padded 12 px each side (space.inset.md); the three 32 × 32 IconButtons centre in the last column at the panel's inner right edge.
Price range and Max ratio headers and values end at their cells' right padding (justify end); Time, Side and depth, Age and Status start at their left padding.
One line each: 'Active, forming' (type.ui.body-strong), '▼ SELL stack ×4' (type.ui.body) and '64,031.0–64,034.9' (type.num.base) in their cells; no header label (type.ui.body) wraps.

The filter row: the caption (type.ui.body) at the panel's inner right edge (justify space-between), centred on the 32 px checkbox row; the panel's 1 px light-grey edge shows on all four sides inside the frame's clip.
'Active, forming' (type.ui.body-strong) reads heavier than 'Tested' (type.ui.body) at scale 1: weight is the status's second carrier (L678).

deviations: The SCR-056 panel is drawn maximised in the 2560 × 1440 frame (2,560 × 1,440), as §3 L177 draws SCR-030's chart panel: §0 L30-32 and §7 give the frame size and 'a neutral panel frame' (L661; §1.2 L110) but no panel size, and a docked workspace narrows it. With two rows shown the panel is empty below the E25-D02 band. The locate target, a BTCUSDT 5m SCR-030 pane, is taken as open behind the panel (the State block), so every row locates and §7.3's shared reason under the caption (L704-705) is not drawn; board 51 draws it.

Column widths: §7 gives the columns, not their widths (the kit's COLS_056 note). The kit's 616 px of data columns are about the sketch's proportions (L663); gen_15.py fit_columns() scales them × 4.052 to 227 / 551 / 616 / 324 / 259 / 519 px so the table spans the panel's 2,536 px inner width (no header or row padding at comfortable, comfort_table()) with the kit's 40 px [⋯] column at its right edge, as the sketch draws it (L663-665), board 13's rule; the kit's builder keeps 656 px of columns in any width. At this width the cells' words sit far apart; whether the panel caps its table's width is E25-D02's (the panel layout, §1.2 L111-112).

The header's [⋯] (sketch L663) is drawn as the rows' ⋯: the more-horizontal glyph in the dark grey in a 32 × 32 CMP-002 IconButton composition centred in the row-menu column (gen_15.py header_menu() and icon_buttons(); board 13 draws the bare glyph); the kit's header leaves that cell empty. §7 gives it no name and no action (copy gaps).

Each ⋯ is a CMP-002 IconButton composition, 32 × 32 (E11-D04 L101: comfortable action buttons; `15` L61: 'icon-only affordance (… row actions)'), its glyph centred, no fill or edge at rest, centred in the 40 px row-menu column (4 px each side, the column unpadded): the kit draws a bare CMP-019 glyph.

Comfortable follows one rule over the whole table, E11-D04 §2's comfortable column for its CMP-049 table (E11-D04 L97-101; E11-D02 D6, §6 L216, steps the chrome the same way): a 32 px header, rows and checkbox (size.row.comfortable; 24 px at compact, `16` §3 L113-114); type.num.base numbers (Time, Price range, Max ratio, Age); type.ui.body header labels, filter caption, side words and checkbox label; 12 px padding each side of every data cell (E11-D04's space.3 12, bound as space.inset.md) and none on the header and rows (gen_15.py comfort_table(), as board 13: the kit's table draws type.num.sm numbers, type.ui.label headers, a type.ui.caption caption and 4 + 8 px padding at both densities); the 40 px [⋯] column holds E11-D04's 32 × 32 action button, unpadded. The status words keep the kit's type.ui.body-strong / type.ui.body; the title and the E25-D02 band (a placeholder, not table copy) keep the kit's type; the panel's 12 px padding is E11-D04's comfortable panel inset. `16` §3 rule 1 (L125) changes spacing only: if the owner rules it to the letter, the type returns to compact's and only the padding steps.

Price range and Max ratio, header and values, are end-aligned in their cells (gen_15.py align_numbers()): prices and percentages are 'right-aligned in tables' (`15` §0.3 rule 6, L40; E11-D04 D4 L117, L225); Time, Side and depth, Age and Status keep the start. The kit's imbalance_table() aligns every cell to the start (boards 12-14 and 49-52: a kit-owner change).

The 13:05 ▲ BUY stack ×5 row (L666, '(… Broken: hidden)') is not drawn: 'Only unfilled (hide broken)' hides it (§7.2 L689); the caption counts it (L690-691) and the State block names it. A broken row's look (regular weight, the row's text in secondary emphasis, L678-679) is board 49's.
'(neutral panel frame)' (L661) is the sketch's label for the frame, not UI copy: it is drawn as the panel's neutral chrome (a 1 px light-grey edge on the paper) and named in the annotation.
The kit names its table node 'CMP-049 table (composition)'; this board renames it 'CMP-049 Table (composition)', `15` L494's name (kit imbalance_table(): a kit-owner change for the other boards).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.
'Active in semibold' (§7.1 L678) is drawn in type.ui.body-strong (medium): no semibold 13 px token exists; the word carries the state.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
